component_split.rationale: Select calibrated Strategy C for Common Pile prose. It preserves substantial representation of the complementary instructional, news, educational and public-domain prose components within their calibrated safe capacities, assigns Gutenberg the residual capacity, avoids repetition, and exactly preserves the 300M final and 330M first-pass Common Pile quotas. Strategy A is excessively Gutenberg-dominated and Strategy B is infeasible under the calibrated 1.15 safety policy.

reviewed_bounds.rationale: Accept calibrated Common Pile operating ceilings derived from the frozen inventory and real six-component calibration, using explicit conservative rate, row, record and storage margins. These are fail-closed operating bounds rather than proven whole-shard maxima; any exceedance requires a new reviewed bound instead of automatic expansion.
